operator.principle: same non-zero displacement-vector multiset, same support size and team, different endpoint/support assignment; response-blind; not a semantic-coalition test; static roles never used as truth

representation_map.centering: global 20-player centroid subtraction INSIDE the differentiable map
representation_map.graph: frozen base-snapshot kNN-4 adjacency reused for base and both perturbed arms; no graph rewiring (same as P3 prospective response)
representation_map.jacobian: J = df/dX_raw via autograd at base point, shape 64x40
representation_map.geometry: G = J^T J (40x40); q_full = 1/2||J delta||^2; q_diag from 2x2 per-node diagonal blocks; q_offdiag = q_full - q_diag
representation_map.observed_response: r = 1 - cosine(f(X), f(X+delta)); Delta r = r_anchor - r_control; same 1-cosine family as P3 prospective response

matched_pair_construction.team_choice: seeded RNG choice of team_slot 0/1 per snapshot; seed = stable_seed(operator_id, snapshot_id, draw)
matched_pair_construction.source_support: seeded choice of 4 nodes within the chosen team (response-blind; no model output, task error, event or role input)
matched_pair_construction.anchor_arm: delta_A = base * epsilon on source support
matched_pair_construction.control_arm: same vector multiset reassigned to a disjoint same-team support via enumerate_vector_bijections + reassigned_vector_field
matched_pair_construction.target_ranking: all disjoint same-team targets x bijections; keep boundary-valid (bound 1.0, tol 1e-9) with matching component_count (require_same_component_count=true); rank by legacy pair_residual score then frequency, topology, target, assignment; top-1
matched_pair_construction.disjoint_supports: required (validate_fracture_supports); no feasible disjoint boundary-valid target => set INCOMPLETE, reported in failure rate

perturbation_magnitude.transfer: EXACT at normalized level: P2 canonical positions use the identical half-pitch convention; frozen P2 formal scope lowest regime (0.25 of [0.25, 0.5]) taken as the single primary magnitude
perturbation_magnitude.visible_pitch_check: all 6 visible IDSSE matches are 105.0x68.0, identical to the P2 default pitch; no physical conversion needed for the normalized definition
perturbation_magnitude.physical_caveat: if J03WQQ pitch dimensions differ, the physical-meter equivalent differs slightly; the model only ever sees normalized units, which is what is frozen here
perturbation_magnitude.single_epsilon_policy: one epsilon only; no hidden-epsilon sweep and no post-hoc selection

snapshot_sampling.eligibility: existing valid 20-player/QC rule from build_snapshots (20 non-GK, 10+10, finite, timestamp spread <= 1ms)
snapshot_sampling.spacing: equally spaced indices over eligible snapshots in canonical order (np.linspace); if fewer eligible, use all
snapshot_sampling.selection_inputs: snapshot order only; no model output/task-error/event/role-based selection

primary: full local geometry (Delta q_full vs Delta r)
diagonal local geometry (Delta q_diag vs Delta r)

simple_baselines.support_size_sanity: constant by construction (s=4); reported, not correlated

validity_and_reporting.valid_set: both arms boundary-valid, finite response, finite q
report: full geometry Spearman with observed pair-effect
validity_and_reporting.degeneracy_guard: if observed-response std <= 1e-12 or valid pairs < 10, mark INTERVENTION_UNDERDEGRADED and do not promote on intervention
validity_and_reporting.scope: one unseen source match, not multi-match population generalization
